beforeImplementation.note: Trace and new bulk/soil APIs fail assertions against working RED signatures; no missing-module fallback

failures.title: bulk null container is a clear input error rather than a property-access TypeError
failures.message: AssertionError: expected error to be instance of RangeError

failures.title: missing soil provenance never borrows the unrelated day-pillar calculation
failures.message: AssertionError: expected { kind: 'DATED', …(4) } to deeply equal { kind: 'MISSING_SOIL_EVIDENCE' }

failures.title: sourceSha256 cannot claim a different astronomy input identity in caller evidence
failures.message: AssertionError: expected function to throw an error, but it didn't

failures.title: astronomyAuthorityId cannot claim a different astronomy input identity in caller evidence
failures.message: AssertionError: expected function to throw an error, but it didn't

failures.title: clockPolicy cannot claim a different astronomy input identity in caller evidence
failures.message: AssertionError: expected function to throw an error, but it didn't

corrections.problem: Null inputs container was read before validation and produced TypeError
corrections.resolution: Validate bulk map containers before pillar/branch consistency check; RangeError/code/key now explicit. Watched the added test fail before patch.

corrections.problem: Missing soil could inherit the unrelated day calculation in its evidence payload
corrections.resolution: Missing soil has explicit MISSING_SOIL_EVIDENCE; never borrows day/month calculations. No presence/Golden changes; watched added test red before patch.

optionalIdentityCorrection.problem: New sourceSha256/astronomyAuthorityId/clockPolicy claims were exported but caller-supplied conflicts were not rejected
optionalIdentityCorrection.resolution: Validate each optional claim when present, retain compatibility with frozen inputs that omit them; 3 added tests observed RED before patch; no frozen expectation changed
